scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,magenta "pnpm api:dev" "pnpm --filter web dev"
scripts.db:migrate: uv run --project apps/api --directory apps/api alembic upgrade head
scripts.gen: uv run --project apps/api python -m tri_mesure.datagen.generate --out data/gold
scripts.gen:api: uv run --project apps/api python -m tri_mesure.export_openapi apps/web/openapi.json && pnpm --filter web gen:api
scripts.lint: uv run --project apps/api --directory apps/api ruff check . && pnpm --filter web lint
